/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
ben = pd.read_csv('beneficiaries.csv')
payments = pd.read_excel('payments.xlsx', header=4)

# clean
payments['Beneficiary ID'] = payments['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
ben['Beneficiary ID'] = ben['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
payments['Status'] = payments['Status'].astype(str).str.strip()

# filter paid
mask_paid = payments['Status'].str.lower() == 'paid'
paid = payments[mask_paid].copy()

# exclude payments whose Beneficiary ID absent from CSV
valid_ids = set(ben['Beneficiary ID'].unique())
paid = paid[paid['Beneficiary ID'].isin(valid_ids)]

# join
merged = paid.merge(ben[['Beneficiary ID','Programme']], on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')

# sum amount
amount_col = 'Amount (INR)'
# ensure numeric
merged[amount_col] = pd.to_numeric(merged[amount_col], errors='coerce')
totals = merged.groupby('Programme')[amount_col].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(totals)
print('Highest:', totals.index[0], totals.iloc[0])
\""
